model: Student-t location-scale model for 55 passage-level noun-minus-verb mean log first-fixation-duration contrasts
prior_note: Both prior scales are calibrated to twice the observed contrast standard deviation; this is a teaching computation target, not a confirmatory analysis.

stress.algorithm: coarse unadapted dynamic HMC with unit metric, step size 0.03, and maximum tree depth 7
stress.interpretation: Intentional computational stress test, not a second inferential fit.
